Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 11

“By this may you nourish the gods, and may the gods nourish you. Nourishing one another, you will attain the highest good.”

The image is mutual feeding, a two-way exchange rather than tribute paid upward. Krishna's cosmos runs on circulation, and refusing to circulate is what jams it.
